description.value: Port Kells Outdoor Pool is a City of Surrey municipal outdoor swimming pool in the Port Kells neighbourhood. It offers public swims and swimming lessons during the summer season. A touring cyclist passing through Surrey's rural-fringe east side could use the pool as a refreshing mid-ride stop on a hot day.
